positioning: Relevant professional engineering achievements prioritized to the target opening without inflating formal level, scope or metrics.

entries.text: Senior engineer and builder of production-facing AI developer workflows: a team-used Codex harness, typed Python MCP integrations, persistent engineering memory and agent-assisted CI repair, grounded in years shipping customer-facing engineering software.
Arm — Senior Software Engineer | Austin, TX | April 2023–Present
Designed a modular Codex engineering harness adopted by several Arm engineers, combining reusable tools, skills, project knowledge and workflow controls.
Built an internal Python MCP interface translating engineering intent into typed backend plans with semantic checks, checkpoints and controlled fallback.
Implemented checkpointed execution, semantic readback and rollback of interconnect configuration changes to support reliable agent-driven automation.
Developed autonomous creation and retrieval of durable technical memory during coding-agent tasks.

Built a team-used Codex CI-repair skill that inspects failed Jenkins/Playwright test cases and iterates targeted repair until three consecutive clean replays, leaving Git publication to human reviewers.
Created a Tauri 2 engineering workbench with React/TypeScript UI and a shared Rust core used by desktop and CLI interfaces.
Shipped production Angular/TypeScript and Python engineering workflows for Arm interconnect customers while serving as functional lead for coherent-mesh GUI tooling.
Arm — Software Engineer | Austin, TX | April 2020–April 2023
Implemented React dashboard components, Flask backend notebook-lifecycle services, PostgreSQL schemas and end-to-end system tests for the Pelion Machine Learning platform.
Used Kubernetes persistent storage backed by AWS EFS for Jupyter notebooks; developed related web services and sensor-data applications with React, Node.js/Express and PostgreSQL.
Arm — Graduate Software Engineer | Austin, TX | January 2019–April 2020
Built FPGA master/slave Verilog test modules and C++ Mbed OS firmware for embedded-board I/O qualification as part of the Mbed OS FPGA CI Test Shield.
**The University of Texas at Austin** — B.S. Electrical and Computer Engineering, December 2018. Focus: Computer Architecture and Embedded Systems; Integrated Circuits.
Codex, MCP, Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Rust, Tauri, React, Angular, Jenkins, Playwright, Git, CI/CD, Linux, Kubernetes, backend APIs.
